senses.gloss:
गृज्, -गृञ्ज् €1 P. (गर्जति or गृञ्जति)
 To sound, roar, grumble &c.

—1 A small red variety of garlic or onion (prohibited as food for द्विज);
 ल्शुनं गृञ्जनं चैव पलाण्डुं कवकानि च । अभक्ष्याणि द्विजातीनाममेध्यप्रभवाणि
 च ॥ Ms. 5. 5; Y. 1. 176.
—2 A turnip.
—3 The tops of hemp chewed to produce intoxication, the Gānjā.
गृञ्जनः + .{@-नम्@} The meat of an animal destroyed by poisoned arrow; ‘अथ गृञ्जनं विषदिग्धपशोर्मांसे’ Med. | Mb. 13. 9. 39.
